summary: Verified the reported logout->login-fails-with-same-credentials bug is FIXED on the web preview. Signup persists (hashed-email key + id-index + session), 3 consecutive logout/login cycles all succeed with no 'Email or password is incorrect' error, full-page reload logout->login also succeeds, wrong password / unknown email are correctly rejected, duplicate signup (also with different casing 'RELOG2@Example.com') is rejected, and case+whitespace login ('  RELOG2@Example.com  ' with correct password) succeeds. Signup completed in ~0.4-0.6s. No calls to *.emergentagent.com/api/*. About page shows 'Version 1.0.6'. FAB navigates to /assessment which shows both mode cards (Quick Analysis / Enhanced Analysis). Note: SecureStore is unavailable on web, so the AsyncStorage fallback path (writeRecord read-back -> setItem) is what was exercised here; the native Keychain path can only be fully verified on a device build.
action_items: None from web preview run. Main agent should still smoke-test the native (Android device) build once, since only that path exercises the real expo-secure-store Keychain branch and the writeRecord read-back verification for it. On device, confirm signup->logout->login also succeeds and that a hashed local_account_<hex> entry is present in SecureStore (or falls back to AsyncStorage and is readable).
critical_code_review_comments: localAuth.ts: hashed account key (sha256 of normalized email) correctly avoids SecureStore's key-charset restriction. writeRecord read-back + AsyncStorage fallback is a sound belt-and-braces approach for web.
localSignUp performs a post-write readAccountByEmail check and rolls back both the account and the id-index entry on failure — correct.
PBKDF2 iterations 60_000 is a reasonable speed/security trade-off; observed signup latency ~0.4-0.6s on web preview, well within the requested 1-3s budget.
normalizeEmail (trim + lowercase en-US) is applied consistently on both signUp lookup and signIn lookup — case/whitespace login works.
No new deprecated Expo packages introduced by this change. (Prior warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' is preexisting, unrelated to auth fix.)
seed_data_creation: Created local account: Relog2 Tester / relog2@example.com / secret123 via the app UI (stored in browser localStorage under hashed key).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storage keys observed on web after signup: [local_account_d826f03f...<64 hex chars>, local_account_id_<uuid>, local_session]. All in window.localStorage (AsyncStorage web shim uses localStorage). Matches regex /^local_account_[0-9a-f]{64}$/ — no '@' or '%' anywhere. No IndexedDB usage. Backend intentionally unused; no /api requests observed.
rca_of_issue: Confirmed root cause matches the report: previously the SecureStore key was 'local_account_' + encodeURIComponent(email), containing '@' and '%25', which SecureStore silently rejects (allowed chars: [A-Za-z0-9._-] only). Because the storage helpers swallow failures, signup appeared to succeed but nothing was persisted; the in-memory React state was the only session, so after signOut the account was gone and signIn always threw 'Email or password is incorrect.' Fix (verified): hash email via SHA-256 and use the hex digest as the SecureStore key (always safe), plus a write->read-back verification with AsyncStorage fallback for platforms without a Keychain (e.g. web). Reproduction is no longer possible on web preview after the fix.
